title: Rush Hour 2
about: Carter and Lee chase a counterfeiting ring from Hong Kong to Las Vegas.
cue: Serve the mains when they hit the Red Dragon casino.
faces: “Carter finally in Hong Kong, and already lost. Get him back before he orders.”
